122779.overview:
While walking through the maze, you must answer the English vocabulary problem that appears at each intersection. A correct reply takes you closer to the exit. But you have to work fast; if you don't answer within a fixed time, the fuse on the bomb will run down and the bomb will explode. And watch out I If you stay in the maze too long, the oxygen supply will run out. WORDMAZE can be played at two levels: beginner and advanced The program in this cartridge contains a total of approxiimately 300 English words. If you want, you can also use the dictionary and enter new vocabulary. WORDMAZE: Will you make it out in time?

Each English word you answer correctly helps you escape from the maze. Try and make it out while there's still oxygen to breathe!

181923.overview: In this game you 're in control of a monster fighter. A warp zone is set in the middle of the screen. Warp to the next level when it flashes. You should attack the monsters before they catch or shoot you. A frog turns up occasionally, shoot it for bonuses. The monsters become more vicious when they change color (they turn from yellow to red to purple). The red and the purple monsters are severe chasers.
